summary_bullets: Add a Codex implementer hard guard for unsupported persistent interactive subprocess sessions
Carry the same subprocess-tool discipline into the Codex CI fixer prompt and manifest bail-token docs
Pin Codex presence, Cursor absence, and rendered CI prompt coverage in offline harnesses
commit_message:
Prohibit Codex interactive subprocess sessions

Add a Codex implementer hard guard for unsupported persistent interactive subprocess sessions, including the stable interactive-subprocess-unsupported bail token.

Carry the same subprocess-tool discipline into the Codex CI fixer prompt and update the manifest schema docs.

Regenerate the Codex implementer prompt, strip the Codex-only guard from the Cursor generator output, and pin the behavior in the implementer and CI launcher harnesses.

oos_observations.title: make lint blocked by review dispatch panel breadcrumb expectation
oos_observations.description: Running make lint failed at test-dispatch-panel-core. A direct rerun of bash skills/review/scripts/test-dispatch-panel.sh --section core exited 1 because the harness expected the breadcrumb line → review: launching 6 reviewers (6 Cursor static, 0 dynamic), but dispatch-panel.sh returned only KV lines for that fixture. This is outside the issue #2991 prompt and launcher scope.
